correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of 281 grid perfect matchings and all 511338 nonempty faces; each of 255663 matched face pairs is a valid codimension-one incidence; topological-sort check of all 511338 directed Hasse vertices proves acyclicity. With one critical 0-cell, two 3-cells, eight 4-cells and one 5-cell, signed integer Morse differentials have exactly one unit coefficient -1 in degree 4 to 3 and zero degree 5 to 4. Hence reduced \(\widetilde H_3=\mathbb Z\), \(\widetilde H_4=\mathbb Z^7\), \(\widetilde H_5=\mathbb Z\) and no others. The Morse complex has no 1- or 2-cells, proving 2-connectivity. The actual standalone checker source was replayed and each claimed value asserted; no claim of a homotopy wedge decomposition.

value.rationale: Four-by-six is the first even-column width-four extension after the natural smaller four-by-four instance and complements the known three-row theorem. Its exact integral homology, with nonzero groups in three distinct consecutive dimensions, is a motivated natural invariant for a currently unsettled class of perfect-matching complexes; it distinguishes width-four topology from uniform one-degree behavior in the three-row family. The finite answer remains substantive without proving a general homotopy-type formula.
